items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Toby Walker... give him five dollars to play George Gershwin's 'I Got Rhythm' very fast

ctx.x: All of this was in this learning process of me meeting some of the greatest musicians in the world, and a lot of times not even being aware of just really how great they were! But all these people used to come...if they came to Washington, they came up to Freddy Woods' place.

Toby Walker, if I can go back to him, was a fabulous pianist. They had a thing, it was sort of a phenomenon I guess you'd call it, that people would come far and wide and give him five dollars to play George Gershwin's "I Got Rhythm" very fast, and play it for an hour himself. And many times I walked in the club there, and he had this very fast striding left hand, and people would be all around...he would be going through one of these hours. And as I said, if someone gave him five dollars, that meant that a lot…

But he'd be sitting there playing, and if it was quiet in there, the minute you walked in the door (this room was way in the back), you could hear it. And I'd go straight back in there. I would walk in, and Toby would be taking a drink with his right hand and striding with his left, and sitting
